vocab.example: Our burndown chart shows we still have about twenty story points left.
vocab.example_vi: Biểu đồ burndown cho thấy chúng ta vẫn còn khoảng hai mươi story point.

vocab.example: The login flow will be demo-ready by Thursday afternoon.

vocab.example_vi: Hãy nói về việc chậm API trong buổi cập nhật hàng tuần vào thứ Hai nhé.

vocab.meaning_vi: sự cho phép, bật đèn xanh

vocab.meaning_vi: biện pháp giảm thiểu rủi ro

listening.title: Weekly progress update with the engineering manager

lines.speaker: Anh Tuấn (Engineering Manager)
lines.text: Hi Linh, thanks for joining. Can you give me a quick update on the mobile app release?

lines.speaker: Linh (Team Lead)
lines.text: Sure. Overall we are about seventy percent done. The burndown chart looks fine for most tasks.

lines.speaker: Anh Tuấn (Engineering Manager)
lines.text: Good. Is anything at risk for the release on the twentieth?

lines.speaker: Linh (Team Lead)
lines.text: Yes, the payment feature. The bank's test environment has been down since Monday, so we can't test it.

lines.speaker: Anh Tuấn (Engineering Manager)
lines.text: I see. What is your mitigation plan?

lines.speaker: Linh (Team Lead)
lines.text: Hoa is writing mock data, so the front end can keep going. But I think we will have a two-day overrun.

lines.speaker: Anh Tuấn (Engineering Manager)
lines.text: Two days is okay if you tell the product team early. What about the new dashboard?

lines.speaker: Linh (Team Lead)
lines.text: The dashboard will be demo-ready on Thursday. Could we show it to the client on Friday?

lines.speaker: Anh Tuấn (Engineering Manager)
lines.text: Yes, you have my green light. Just send me the demo link the day before.

lines.speaker: Linh (Team Lead)
lines.text: Will do. I'll also share a realistic estimate for the payment work in our weekly check-in.
